text: Sapos yu raun wantaim wanpela 'laptop' o 'tablet', putim wanpela kopi insait long 'memory' o 'disc' (we yu no inap nidim intanet long kisim).

Long sait bilong dispela hevi bilong fainens (finance) long graun, Zapatero i kontinu (continue) na i tok olsem "'financial system' em i wanpela pat bilong ekonomi (economy), wanpela impoten pat.

Long olgeta yia long kain taim olsem Oktoba klostu 1.5 milien animal we i save kaikai gras i save i go long ol 'southern plain', brukim Mara River, long ples ol i stap long en long ol 'northern hill' long go long ren.
King Sejong em i namba foa king bilong Joseon Dynasty na em i wanpela bilong ol king ol lain i save givim bikpela rispek long em.

Rom i bin go pas long lukautim wok bilong sios long tausen yia na planti pawa na moni i stap long Rom. Dispela i mekim na planti manmeri i wok long i gat tupela tingting sapos em i inapim dispela bilip, o nogat.
Tasol Royal Navy bilong ol em i strong moa long German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) na ol i inap long bagarapim ol lain bilong pait we i kam long English Channel.
Em i klia tru olsem, sapos yu save long wanpela Romance tok ples, em bai isi moa long yu long lainim Portuguese.
Kruger National Park (KNP) i stap long hap 'north-east' bilong South Africa na i ran arere long bod bilong Mozambique long is, Zimbabwe long not, na boda long hap saut em Crocodile River.
Ol i bin putim paia long wanpela kalabus bilong Iraq, Abu Gharaib taim dispela pait i bin kamap.
Tasol, nau i gat ol 'graffiti artist', 'graffiti events' na "'legal" walls'. Ol 'graffiti painting' bilong ol dispela lain em i save soim ol 'artwork' na i no ol samting we lo i tambu long em.

Dispela lain bilong Mumbai we i kam long pait i kam long bot long Novemba 26, 2008, na ol i karim ol 'grenades', 'automatic weapon', na i bagarapim moa long wanpela samting wantaim Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus trein (train) stesin we ol planti manmeri i save pulap long en na Taj Mahal Hotel we planti lain i save long en.

ol i save pilai long etinpela hol long wanpela 'regualr round', we ol plaiya (player) i stat long namba wan hol bilong 'course' na pinis long namba etin hol.
Ol 'mutation' i ken kamapim kainkain samting na ol i save kamap bikos long wanem kain 'mutation', impoten wok bilong dispela hap 'genetic material' na sapos dispela ol 'cell' em ol 'germ-line cell'.
Dispela teritori (territory) longpela bilong em i moa long 1,600 kilomita (1,000 mi) na bikpela bilong em i 800 km (500 mi), na seip (shape) bilong i klostu wankain olsem wanpela 'rectangle'.
Hamilton i tokaut olsem tru tru Howard University Hospital i kisim dispela sikman na em i stap long gutpela kondisen.
Gavana bilong Massachusetts long bipo Mitt Romney i winim 'Florida Republican Party presidential primary election' long Tunde wantaim 46 pesen bilong ol vot (vote).
JAS 39C Gripen i pundaun antap long rot bilong balus long eapot long 9:30 am long lokel taim (0230 UTC) na paia i kirap, na dispela i mekim na eapot i pas long ol balus bilong mekim moni long ron.

Dominican Republic (Tok Ples bilong Spain: República Dominicana) em i wanpela kantri bilong Caribbean we i stap insait long hap ist bilong ailan Hispaniola, na i serim dispela ailan wantaim kantri Haiti
Dispela bikpela win na ren, we i stap kain olsem 3,000 'mile' long Miami, Florida, i bin karim 'maximum' mak bilong win olsem 40 mph (64 kph).
"Panama Papers" em i wanpela bikpela hap tok we i toktokk long kain olsem ten milien pepa bilong wanpela 'law firm' bilong Panama Mossack Fonseca, we sampela lain i givim i go long jenelis.
Nadal i kisim 88% poin long gem na em i winim 76 poin long 'first serve'.
Nem bilong ol lain we i mekim dispela hevi em Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.
Dispela PBS progrem i winim moa long 24-pela Emmy award, na em i ron sotpela taim moa long Sesame Street na Mister Roger's Neighborhood.
Ol i karim dispela man biling kisim foto i go long Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, we em i stap i go na em i dai.
"Em i luk nais tru na tu, em i save singsing gut," em i tok olsem insait long wanpela 'news conference' rekoding.
Wanem kain we bai 'gravity' bilong 'lo' i pulim mi? Sapos yu sanap antap long graun bilong 'lo', hevi bilong yu bai i liklik moa long hevi bilong yu long Earth.

Bikpela win na ren, i kamap long mak olsem 645 'miles' (1040 km) west long ol ailan bilong Cape Verde, i luk olsem dispela bai i pinis bilong long em i go klostu long ol ailan na kamapim bagarap, ol 'forcaster' i tok.
Ol i save mekim planti raun i go long ol rip long olgeta taim insait long wanpela yia, na bagarap i kamap long bodi long ol dispela kain samting i save kamap wanwan taim tasol.
Dispela geim (game) em ol i save pilai long gras, na ol i gras ww i raunim hol em ol i save katim em i go got moa na ol i save kolim em olsem 'green'.
Dispela pait i putim bikpela hevi antap long rilesensip namel long India na Pakistan.

Ansa i mekim ripot olsem, "polis i wok long tingting planti olsem ol i ken kilim sampela lida bilong ol mafia na dispela i ken kamapim bikpela woa insait long ol mafia long husat bai i kisim ples bilong dispela lida.

Dispela em i planti ol lain i lusim skul i wok long mekim, dispela em i mekim ol i kisim wanpela yia long malolo bipo long ol i go long univesiti, na ol i no stopim skul bilong ol.

I gat ol Kristen bilip we i toktok long dispela tredisen (tradition), tasol em i wankain olsem tredisen bilong Spring na Fertility bipo long taim bilong Kristen bilip.
Disisen bilong NBA i kamap bihain long Jazz pleiya (player) bilong Utah i kisim positif risalt (result) long test bilong em long COVID-19 vaires (virus).
Kondisen bilong presiden em i orait, tasol ol bai i mekim em i stap long 'isolation' long sampela de.

Taim dispela 'capsule' i kam long Earth na i kam insait long 'atmosphere', long kain olsem 5am ('eastern time'), em bai putim wanpela 'show' bilong lait long ol lain long Northern Carlifonia, Oregon, Nevada, na Utah.

Mipela i gat wanpela longpela yia bilong 'financial crises', we nogut bilong em i kamap long tupela mun i go pinis, na mi ting olsem nau ol 'financial market' i wok long kamap orait gen."

Dispela em bikos ilektrisiti (electricity) i wok long ron i go insait long 'socket' we hap bilong balb (bulb) i gat metel (metal) long em i save sindaun na dispela i ken givim yu bikpela 'electric shock' sapos yu tasim insait bilong 'socket' o metel hap bilong balb taim em i pas liklik yet long 'socket'.

Maus bilong em i gat moa long 70-pela tit we i sap olsem resa, wantaim wanpela narapela lain tit we i stap long ruf bilong maus. Dispela em i min olsem wanem samting em i bungim bai i no inap long ranawe.
Ol sampela samting long 'nature' i ken wok wantaim long kamapim ol gutpela kondisen, we i larim dispela 'algae' long kamap planti tru insait long sotpela taim tasol.

'Blogging' em i wanpela tul (tool) we i save mekim ol lain i wok wantaim, na i strongim ol sumating long surikim samting ol i lainim i go autsait moa long wanem samting ol i save lainim long wanpela de insait long skul.
Stesin bilong dispela websait kolim dispela 'show' olsem "wanpela redio drama we i bihainim ol stail bilong bipo tasol i gat nupela na narapela kain kleva (clever) stail long em!"

Dispela 'outbreak' i mekim na gavman bilong India i mekim ol dispela samting kain olsem salim ol lain bilong holimpasim pik i go long ol eria we planti pik i sik na i stap, na givim tausen moskito keten (curtain) na spreyim (spray) ol 'pesticide'.
Dispela kantri i gat ol nambis we i gat waitpela wesan na ol maunten, na tu em i gat olpela siti tru long Americas i stap long en. Nau, dispela siti i stap insait long Santo Domingo.
Long arere bilong dispela sios, i gat ol narapela kain stetu (statue) bilong ol balus pisin we ol i wokim long 'marble' na i stap antap long sampela ston.
